corrections.text: The article states that the release notes "are the only source cited here." The article cites two sources: the v1.0.0 release notes and the project's tracking issue #2619.

The article states that "the notes do not explain the difference between the two vLLM figures." The core component table annotates its vLLM v0.31.0 entry "(varies per accelerator)" and the model-server table lists different tags per accelerator image (vllm-openai v0.30.0; TPU, XPU, ROCm and CPU images v0.31.0). The notes do not say why the vllm-openai image is at v0.30.0 while the core table lists v0.31.0.
